218443.overview:
This compilation includes the next titles:

Alien 8
Beach Head 2
Daley Thompson's Supertest
Raid Over Moscow

Alien 8:

On a dying planet in a distant galaxy, the last of the creatures known as the "guardians" stored all of their libraries, records, and knowledge on a single starship together with cryogenically preserved members of their race. A single robot, Alien 8, is tasked with keeping the occupants of the vessel alive for the duration of its journey.

The ship is launched towards a new solar system, and Alien 8 performs his task for thousands of years during the journey. However, as the ship nears its destination, it is attacked and boarded by hostile aliens. The cryogenic life support systems were damaged during the attack, and Alien 8 must restore them to an operational status before the ship's automatic thrusting systems manoeuvre it into planetary orbit.

Beach Head 2:

There are four levels in the game. In the first level, called Attack, the player deploys soldiers along a path with walls to cover him from the dictator's gun. The objective is to destroy the gun. The second level involves rescuing the prisoners from deadly obstacles by clearing them with a gun. The third level's objective is to escape from the area by flying a helicopter with the prisoners out of the dictator's fortress. Finally, the player and the dictator face off, on opposite cliffs, separated by water. To defeat him, the player must make him fall in the water by throwing knives at him. The Dictator tries to do the same to the player.

Daley Thompson's Supertest:

This game features a variety of sporting events. Each one has its own world record and a target time/distance/score to reach. Fail, and the player loses one of three lives. After completing all events successfully, they repeat with tougher targets. This game features eight sporting events: cycling, giant slalom, penalties, pistol shooting, rowing, ski jumping, springboard diving, and tug of war, while the ZX Spectrum 128K release has four additional events: 100 metres hurdles, javelin, sprint, and the triple jump, making twelve games in all.

Raid Over Moscow:

The USSR has launched a huge attack on the USA, and the only hope for the free world is for you (as the leader of a US Squadron of fighters) to destroy their defense bases. This is done in a multi-stage action game with some similarities to the same developer's Beach Head. All the mini-games must be completed before the time limit on the bomb is expired.

218447.overview:
This compilation includes the next games:

Avenger: Way of the Tiger 2
Breakthru!
Desert Fox
Konami's Golf
The Goonies

Avenger: Way of the Tiger 2

In the sequel to The Way of the Tiger, Yaemon the Grand Master of Flame is the villain of the piece. He has killed your foster-father Naijish and stolen the Scrolls of Kettsuin.

Your quest to recover the scrolls and avenge your father's death is viewed from above and superficially resembles Gauntlet. 

Breakthru!

BreakThru is a 2D side-scrolling vehicle shooter. Your mission: race, jump, and blast your way through five levels (mountains, bridge, plains, city, and airfield) of enemy defenses to recapture the stolen jet fighter. A host of enemy soldiers, mines, vehicles, and aircraft will try to stop you, though. Oh yeah... and don't forget to watch out for those rocket attacks and falling rocks!

Desert Fox

The player takes the role of tank commander, Lone Wolf, who has to foil Rommel's plans in Northern Africa. The strategic part of the game plays on a overhead map, which shows Lone Wolf and Rommel's positions. The overall goal is to save the Allied depots, which are attacked by Rommel's troops - the main challenge is to save all of them in time. Lone Wolf can be moved over the map, and one airstrike per game can be used to buy time for one depot. Lone Wolf also has the ability to gain enemy intel with his radio - this is useful in order to find out where obstacles await.

Konami's Golf

Konami's Golf features a challenging 18 hole course, and allows you, to choose your club, adjust your stance, and control your swing, applying hook, and slice if desired (or inadvertently added). Wind and ball lie must be taken into account.

The Goonies

Based on the Steven Spielberg film of the same name, in which a motley crew of suburban kids in Astoria, Oregon, must save their homes from being foreclosed, and find their salvation in a treasure map leading to an old pirate ship in a cavern. However, they must maneuver around an eccentric family of Italian criminals -- the Fratellis -- who are also on the trail of the treasure.

218467.overview:
This compilation includes the next games:

Bravestarr
Captain America
Rampage
Rygar: Let's Fight !!!
Solomon's Key
Trantor: The Last Stormtrooper
World Class Leaderboard

Bravestarr

The planet of New Texas is similar to the Wild West-era Texas - mystic Indians, bar-room brawlers and sharp-shooting mercenaries. The only man tough enough to keep order in such a place is Marshall Bravestarr. Stampede is the villain of the piece; he aims to bring the dead back to life as zombies for his own use.

BraveStarr is a side-scrolling action title based on the popular 80's space western cartoon series. Starting with a limited amount of time, you must find and rescue Shamen, who was captured by the evil Tex Hex, to aid Stampede's plans. You get nine minutes to complete your task.

Captain America

Rampage

George, Lizzy and Ralph were just ordinary Americans, until an experiment went wrong, turning them into a Gorilla, Lizard and Werewolf respectively. Following this, the three of them plan to go round destroying buildings, and up to 3 human players can join in.

Smashing at the edges of the buildings for long enough will make them collapse. The police and military are after you, and will shoot at you, so try to destroy them (failing that, you can avoid the bullets). You will need to eat regularly, with things like plants on offer, to avoid shrinking back to being human.

Rygar: Let's Fight !!!

An evil being known as Ligar is about to conquer the land of Argool. Such is his power that no living creature dares to cross paths with him. But the legendary warrior Rygar rises from his grave to restore peace and justice. Armed with his famed weapon Diskarmor, Rygar begins to traverse the vast lands that lead to the lair of the demon, as his minions are trying in vain to stop him...

Solomon's Key

Solomon's Key is a platform game with both action and strategy elements. On each level your goal is to retrieve a key which can then be used to unlock the exit. To help out, you have a magic wand which can be used to create and destroy blocks (though some blocks can't be destroyed). In order to reach the key you will need carefully to arrange the blocks on the screen so you can jump your way around safely. 

Trantor: The Last Stormtrooper

You play the role of a man, who has been stranded on an alien planet, after his space ship explodes, and you must find pieces of it to rebuild it. The gameplay, involves you jumping across platforms and shooting at droids and aliens, but also ducking to avoid high flying robots. The game is played from a side scrolling perspective. The baddies, come thick and fast, and the only way to cope is to keep moving.

World Class Leaderboard

It is a Golf game. Wind, snap, and power are the main considerations as players dodge the bunkers, water, and rough, which make for more complex courses.

A course editor is included. The courses provided include real locations: St.

218511.overview: As Angelique, your task is to survive trials, and tribulations, to meet up with Arnold, with whom you have, well, something or other, anyway.

218521.overview:
The Walled City of Antescher has rested for a thousand, thousand years in the midst of the Great Desert inhabited by only the deadly Ants who have made it their home. The sands have piled up at the walls but for some reason have never encroached upon the city proper. The City rests dreaming of past glories, solid and unmoving; the signature of a long dead race. The City washed clean by the sun's rays. The city lost from the world of men for days without number.

Then one day, one year, one hour, He arrived and She arrived, some say that they are descended from a race of wizards, some say that they are descended from a race hidden in a green valley at the North Pole. Who can really tell these days, how much do we really know about the world as it was, or as it is, after so long in the cold Dark Ages. Only Antescher seems to stand inviolate after all this time, teeming with secrets, yet silent.

He and She arrived to play their games through the wind-swept streets, ousting the ants from their exclusive occupation. He and She are now wreaking havoc through the ants who for their part kill and kill again without thought or consideration, just carrying out a biological imperative. He and She run to and fro, climbing in and out the buildings, the sound of their feet stretching from block to block. They laugh and cry out in fear walking with each other just ahead of the Ants and Death.

And above all the drama within it's walls the City of Antescher watches and watches waiting for the next renaissance and the next Golden Age. The City seems to have a presence, a huge brooding entity which hangs over the buildings and which in some mysterious way controls the destiny of those below...

The game consist on 10 levels in which you have to save your companion depending on the sex of the character yoyu choose.

218527.overview:
You are the greatest specialist in penetrating communication networks between computers. By trying to enter a banking entity, you arrive in fact unwittingly on the defense control system of the USA. An error on your part will cause missiles to be launched against the Soviet block. 

The fate of the world is in your hands, it's up to you to avoid the Apocalypse!

Use missiles, interceptors, radars, planes, submarines and satellites with discernment. In the movie, it was just a war game, but in reality...

218530.overview:
The collection includes:

Archon: The Light And The Dark
Archon 2: Adept

Archon: The Light And The Dark

Is a strategic board game with some similarities to chess. Two sides, a light one and a dark one, consisting of 18 pieces each compete on a board divided into (9 by 9) squares. You win the game by having one of your units on each of the five powerpoint squares, by removing all opposing pieces from the board or by imprisoning the last remaining creature of the opposing side.

However, you can't just remove a piece from the board by landing on it. When two pieces clash, the outcome is decided in the battle arena during one-on-one real-time combat. 

Archon 2: Adept

Each side plays as an Adept - a powerful wizard with the ability to cast spells against other Adepts and his summonings - and must defeat the other side, either Chaos or Order, by attacking him/her with summoned Elementals or Demons. Each side can summon 4 unique elementals at a time or choose from 4 demons, common to both.

Gameplay is similar to the original, reminiscent of a chess-like board game, requiring strategy, but with arcade elements, especially when two adepts confront each other face-to-face. The board also shifts from time to time, making the strategy less predictable.

218534.overview: Drawing assistance software that offers circles, fill-ellipses, cubes, text, scrolling and lines in a palette of 27 colors (16 simultaneously in low resolution, 4 in medium and 2 in high). You can keep the most beautiful samples on K7 or diskette. Very easy to use.

218543.overview: Learning music while having fun. Here, fortunately, Astromus asks you to defend your two space bases, namely the key of Sol and the key of Fa threatened by sometimes invisible enemies, which does not help.

218546.overview: Astroscope is a French language game based on the pseudoscience of Astrology. It was developed by Jérôme Vallet and published by No Man's Land in 1985.

218549.overview: Atomic Battle is a space shooter that appeared in the magazine Computing With The Amstrad Vol 2 No 10. The player's task is to destroy incoming electrons, which increases with each new level. At the same time, you should avoid radioactive dust and bullets of the enemy robot, which can be briefly immobilized by firing a shot at it.

218550.overview:
Atomic has a little something that immediately catches your eye. Based on the theme of atomic physics, more specifically molecular composition. The game is made up of several levels with increasing difficulty. At the beginning of each table, you have a certain number of atoms which all have a value ranging from 1 to 4.

The principle of Atomic consists in assembling horizontally and/or vertically all these atoms together so as to bring all their values ​​to 0. When the molecule thus constituted sees the value of all its atoms cancel each other out, a chain reaction will disappear from the board. The goal is to get rid of all the atoms you have in stock to move to the next level.

218572.overview:
AYO is a computerised version of a traditional African board game, Mancala, involving a lot of skill and a little luck too. You can play it with a friend or against the computer.

The game is traditionally played on a long wooden board into which two rows of six cup-like hollows are carved. These are referred to as houses. In addition there are usually two large score houses at opposite ends of the board.

The counters used in Ayo are traditionally seeds of the plant caesalpinia crista, which grows in West Africa.

218673.overview: Is an unofficial sequel to Abu Simbel Profanation, and it starts in the same place, where the first part has ended. The words cursed Johnny Jones heard in the mortuary chamber gave him, even at that moment of terror, a hope: "See you at the North Pole". So, based on his calculations, he should cross the hollow Earth through the zone of stones, the jungle zone and the ice zone according to the legends hoping to reach 'The Pole' and hoping to escape Abu Simbel. The gameplay is extremely hard side view platformer, where the player should jump with a highest accuracy and avoid the numerous obstacles.

219691.overview:
Amstrad Academy was the first in what was intended to be a range of compilations from U.S. Gold under the Master Games label.  As it would turn out, this was the only release made under the banner for the CPC.

Featured games are:

219907.overview:
Released exclusively as part of the Cascade 50 games collections (Cassette 50 and Disc 50).

You are an assassin who must guide a poison dart by remote control through a defence system to your target in the bottom right hand corner of the screen.  You must avoid hitting the walls or the guardians who patrol the maze and you're against the clock too.

424643.overview:
One of the most popular and influential games of the 1980s. Pac-Man is a small yellow eater whose task is to clear the maze of all the dots on the board. From time to time, a fruit will appear in the maze, visible at the top of the screen, giving bonus points after eating it. The task is hindered by four wandering ghosts, with contact with them taking one of the three available lives. Fortunately, to escape from them, you can use a tunnel transferring to the opposite side of the board or eat a large dot giving you a temporary opportunity to devour them for bonus points. During this time, the ghosts turn blue and, after being eaten, their eyes float back to the central box where they regenerate to chase the player again.

An unofficial conversion of the commercial BBC game Snapper.

424649.overview: In this puzzle game, the player's task is to collect all the bags on the board and head to the exit. To do this, you need to position blocks accordingly, which can be eliminated by hitting them from below or above. There is a certain amount of time to complete the task and an additional complication is the enemy creatures moving around the board.

424656.overview: The player's task is to land a bomb and drop it on the alien ship. Each collision with an enemy object takes away some of the energy you have, and its loss ends the game. The ship is equipped with a laser, which effectively exterminates incoming aliens.

424658.overview: Zadaniem gracza przy pomocy postaci z jet-pack`iem jest przechodzenie plansz z przeszkodami. Zadanie utrudnia upływający czas, który można zwiększyć zbierając po drodze rozrzucone przedmioty.

424661.overview: The player's task is to collect all the items in the maze within a certain time while avoiding encounters with hostile creatures. It's worth remembering the layout of the corridors, because in subsequent boards the walls will become invisible.

424670.overview: The player takes on the role of an FBI or KGB agent and explores the mansion in search of pieces of floppy disks with important data. While wandering around, you can also find guns to eliminate guards and grenades, used with the G key, to pave the way in no-go situations. Flashing platforms allow you to move the robot to a floor above by pressing the SPACE key.

424671.overview: The player's task is to lead the frog to a safe lair at the top of the screen. The task would be simple if it weren't for the fact that the route leads through a busy street and a rushing river with logs and turtles. Falling into the water is as tragic as being smashed by a vehicle. Once all the frogs have been placed in their lairs, the next, more difficult level to overcome will begin.

424681.overview: A classic shooter in which the player's task is to exterminate all the aliens on the screen.

424716.overview: Poor Fizzog crashes on Earth and regains consciousness in Area 51. The player's task is to collect all the crystals scattered in different areas of the board, necessary to repair the space scooter. Unfortunately, each room is fraught with obstacles and hostile objects, contact with which takes one of the five lives and makes it necessary to collect all the crystals from the beginning.

424729.overview: The player's task is to get four batteries to the red receiver while avoiding an encounter with the flashing robot. To do this, use stone blocks by moving or destroying them so that they are an obstacle for the batteries. The stone block can also be used to destroy the robot, which will immediately appear elsewhere on the board.

424758.overview: The player's task is to collect white balls appearing randomly on the board. The task would be easy if not for the fact that you can't enter the red trail left behind and the passing time detonates a bomb taking the player's life. It is also necessary to avoid contact with various creatures. For points you can collect flags.

424778.overview: The player's task is to reach the object marked with the letter F. While wandering, you can collect objects marked with the letter C, to which they give points.

447305.overview:
The player drives a racing vehicle and his task is to collect all the dots on the board. The task is interfered with by the other driver, who tries to make the two vehicles collide.

The game is a French clone/variant of the arcade classic, Head-On.

449130.overview: This is an English-language musical quiz on Christmas carols.  Listen to an excerpt from the carol, guess which song it is.  Released as part of the 'Christmas Crackers' compilation from Database Publications (publishers of Computing With the Amstrad) - exclusively available by mail order at the time.

449148.overview: You play the role of Wuntover, apprentice to the great magician Ebeneezum who one day disappears.  Desperate with worry, you take it upon yourself to find him and rescue him from whatever perils have befallen him.

449151.overview:
You have to rescue your princess and find the time machine to escape from the hell of the Middle Ages. Easier said than done.

The action is seen from above and you must fight the soldiers attacking you. Once you have found your beloved, run out of the castle and try to stay alive.

449153.overview:
Your hands. They hit the reinforced metal. They're starting to hurt. There's nothing to do.

The safety lock is engaged.

A1RLOCK is a survival text adventure about a child and some voices. Also, a lot of proteins. If you are looking for the kind of game that goes: "This is what happened and this is what you must do", A1RLOCK is probably not for you as it has an in meda res approach and may as a result be obscure to many players until quite far into the playthrough.

A1RL0CK (PUNYJAM #3)

Written by Marco INNOCENTI
Tested by Andrew SCHULTZ , Gianluca GIRELLI and Garry FRANCIS.

★ UPDATES:

- Rel 1.0 : An entrant in PunyJam #3 games contest in March 2023 , which finished 2nd (ex-aequo) out of 8 entries overall.
- Rel 3.2 is the post-PunyJam#3 polished version with an added scoring system and a lot of vanilla systems in which to play , and we recommend you play this one. Check 'ReadMe.txt' for a full disclosure on what changed in the game.

★ INFOS:

- CONTENT WARNING : May contain scenes not suitable for all audiences, like physical violence and psychological torment.
- This game was programmed using Inform, which generates Z-code files that are also used by Infocom's range of text adventures.
- All versions are courtesy of Stefan VOGT and his incredible Puddle BuildTools. Other IF by the author can be found at AndromedaLegacy.com. Rovarsson was also pretty helpful in finding missing verbs and interactions.
- It uses the PunyInform libraries by Johan BERNTSSON and Fredrik RAMSBERG, and of course Inform6 by Graham NELSON (and a lot of other people).

449175.overview:
Welcome to A Case of Murder. You are Sam Boon an L.A. Private Detective (or so your permit says, as yet you haven't had any cases). You might be a good detective, a great detective or a total flop, your actions will decide your future.

The time is around about midday on the 1st of June 1968. You have just moved into your new premises to setup shop. Everything is poised to begin.

INFOS:

- There are two versions for the Amstrad CPC both are available in DSK format. The first version is full-screen text only. The second version is half-screen and uses high res graphics in key locations.
- The game is an old-school text adventure, so put away your joysticks and get your fingers ready for some typing exercises.

450471.overview: The city is overrun with gangsters, and the mayor has enlisted Timothy Gunn to deal with them. Your mission is simple; shoot everyone you see! Some gangsters carry evidence, which you will need to collect in order to go to the next level. Other gangsters carry guns, which when collected will also restore a small amount of your energy. Also beware of snipers, whose crosshairs will appear on the screen if you are too slow to gather evidence! This game was an entrant in the 2018 #CPCRetroDev Game Creation Contest and it finished in fourth place, and the gameplay is very similar to the first level of The Untouchables. The graphics are very colourful, the scrolling is amazingly fast, and the music is good. However, the inclusion of the sniper can make this game frustrating to play and it would have been better without this feature.

450507.overview:
Deep within a military compound lies something secret that has been obtained by an enemy nation – but what is it? Enter our hero, who has to explore the compound, find the safe where the secret is stored, blow up the safe, and get out! The enemy base is swarming with guards, and you will need to use stealth to try to prevent them from spotting you. Firstly, you’ll need to acquire a gun, then you need to obtain ammunition for it. Other objects to be found in crates are tin cans (extra energy), coloured cards to open doors, and dynamite for blowing up the safe. After eight previous attempts, CNGSoft finally won the #CPCRetroDev Game Creation Contest in 2023 with this effort.

UPDATES:

- 20231231/r1: enemies are more aggressive now: they actually use their machine guns as such! enemies drop ammo in an alarm, food otherwise; enemies take several seconds to spawn when the game begins, avoid spawning or warping too close, and show muzzle flashes when they shoot. Messages are shown when picking or using items rather than just when using dynamite or cards.

- 20231102: compo version.

452655.overview:
Many years ago, Jesper Goldenstark discovered a previously unknown planet and he discovered powerful crystals containing large reserves of energy. However, once the planet's resources were exhausted, chaos ensued and the colony was left in ruins. This game consists of four parts that tell the story of Jesper's descendants and the rise and fall of the colony.

INFOS:

- An unofficial conversion of the ZX Spectrum game of the same name.
- Created with Arcade Game Designer.

454292.overview: Anima woke up in a strange place and doesn't remember what happened. Travel with her through four worlds and beat all the bosses of these worlds so you can progress on this adventure.

454304.overview:
It's been 31 years since Arnold Weinstock introduced the AMSTRON program on the 08Z chip. It has always been believed that this chip was 8 kB of RAM memory without addressing and useless. That chip carried a latent program that was executed on October 21, 2015, making all AMSTRAD that executed it come to life.

Now AMSTRON has taken control of your CPC, fighting a life and death battle between the Z80 and the 08Z. Take control of your fastest bits through the tracks on your board and get to take control of your AMSTRAD.

454339.overview: As a rescue space policeman, you must find all the kittens scattered throughout the universe and give them the life they deserve.

454393.overview:
Spring has arrived and we must collect all the food possible to face the harsh winter. In the first scene we must collect as many apples as possible hitting the tree with our tail so that they fall from it, we cannot load more than 8 apples in the basket, before we must store them in our den or they will fall off. Mr. Owl does not agree with our methods and has arranged a series of bombs in order to make you give up on your attempts.

Scene 2 takes place in the river, the same thing happens in the forest, but this time Mr. Crab is not willing to let you steal his fish and he will have dynamite to frustrate your attempts.

Finally, scene 3 takes place in the factory in the forest, there you make the apple sauce and can the fish, but the mice that live there consider that you need so much food and they will try to rob you by throwing forks at you. Each scene consists of 3 difficulty phases in A mode and 6 in B mode, if you exceed more than 8 items in the basket you lose a life, if an object hits you, you lose a life, if you drop food on the ground, you lose points totals, if you pass scene you gain extra life.

455400.overview:
The world is on the brink of destruction and a full scale nuclear war seems inevitable.

You must destroy all of the Soviet Bloc's missile launch silos before they destroy yours...

456340.overview:
A 2015 homebrew port of the Apple II classic.

Once, the land of Akalabeth was peaceful and quiet. But then came Mondain, an evil and ambitious man who created dungeons and populated them with foul creatures. The noble warrior British was able to drive Mondain from Akalabeth, but the monsters he brought with him remain.

As either a fighter or a mage, it is your job to explore Akalabeth, descend into the dungeons and vanquish the beasts dwelling within. On an overhead map of the land, one can find the dungeons, towns where one may buy supplies, weapons and armor, and a castle, where one will be given quests by Lord British. To fulfill such a quest, a certain type of creature must be destroyed in a dungeon.

Inside the dungeons, the view switches to a first-person perspective. Fight, explore and find treasure on your way to complete a quest. Each successive quest will require you to destroy a stronger monster, which will reside on a deeper dungeon level than the one before it.

456348.overview:
You've been working on the newly constructed Aljau Dam for two weeks. An unexpected heavy rain has caused power outages throughout the complex.

The reservoir's capacity is increasing alarmingly. Power must be restored to open the four locks before it exceeds its maximum capacity, approximately 7,000 hm3.

The main objective is to relieve the water from the dam, otherwise it will collapse, causing a catastrophe.

456424.overview:
The player's task is to stop the invasion of tanks crossing the bridge in a certain amount of time. Each tank moves at different speeds and you must drop a bomb at the right moment to hit the target. Another bomb can be dropped after the previous one has disappeared.

COLLECTION: The Amstrad Games Book.

456682.overview:
Ascend is a platform game where the objective is to reach the top floor of each stage by climbing ladders, while avoiding enemies.

The stage layouts get more complex as the game progresses. There is a time limit in each stage, and the faster the top is reached, the better the score. Figuring out the best ways to reach the top gives the game a puzzle aspect, similar to titles such as Lode Runner.

However, in Ascend the player doesn't have the ability to dig holes. Instead, the player character can jump against blocks so that they can act as barriers for enemies, who would otherwise pose a danger as touching them leads to a loss of the limited lives of the player. There is also an exclamation mark symbol appearing during stages which gives invincibility once collected.

456685.overview: Port of the fan-game with the same name for C64 created by Arno Weber. There are 16 caves, each consisting of several scrolling screens. Each cave has 5 Difficulty levels. In each cave you will find different obstacles (boulders, walls, etc.) and possibly enemy creatures you will need to avoid or trap while collecting or creating diamonds.

456718.overview:
The year is 1990.  The world is divided into two main camps: The ASU (Amstrad Socialist Union) and the NGPA (New Generation Platforms Alliancy).

There is a cold war between them, as NGPA wants to suppress and occupy the ASU countries.  In this context, the invaluable painting "Amstradian Excellence" from the famous painter Pablo di Casso was stolen from the ASU central museum by the NGPA secret forces. The NGPA now exposes the painting in their museum, as loot. Your mission is to go to the NGPA museum, retrieve the painting and return safely to the ASU capital.

456819.overview: Auto Amy is a puzzle game where you need to make a path to the exit by placing tiles. There are three jewels to collect on each level, and various mechanics such as warps (skip a space) and X blocks that you bounce off and reverse direction.
